purpose: Test original material color assignments in Enfusion before packed textures or illumination calibration
reference_color_mapping: Copy original base_color_linear numbers directly as a candidate material constant mapping; color transfer is not proven
region_selection: Chosen on the previously published white-material geometry control before either new capture

positive_control.left_wall: Mean R exceeds both G and B by more than 20 RGB8 code values
positive_control.right_wall: Mean B exceeds both R and G by more than 20 RGB8 code values

limits: Color-response control only; no accepted photometric match or appearance training pair
Materials remain default roughness/metalness without packed maps
Outdoor engine illumination differs from the original reference area light
No neural processing, renderer-buffer access or performance measurement
